issues.description: Method name/signature mismatch for the meal-cost calculation: the problem statement and UML specify a static method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int, but the template/solution code uses a static method named computeMealCost(Meal) instead. This naming mismatch (problem vs. code) will confuse students about which method to implement/use and may cause test-suite or autograder mismatches.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Either (A) rename the method computeMealCost(Meal) in the template and solution to calculateTotalPrice(Meal) (keeping it static and returning int), and update any callers (e.g., Main) accordingly; or (B) update the problem statement/UML to refer to computeMealCost(Meal): int instead of calculateTotalPrice. Ensure the chosen name, signature, and staticness match in the problem text, template, and solution so students are not confused.

issues.description: The problem statement (UML and text) requires a method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal) (and states it must be static). The solution implements the same functionality under a different identifier computeMealCost(Meal) (static) in SealSaloon, while the commented example in the template Main uses computeMealCost and the commented example in the solution Main calls calculateTotalPrice. These divergent names for the same conceptual operation (computing the total price/cost of a meal) create ambiguity for students: they may implement the method with the name from the problem (calculateTotalPrice) while the template comments/reference use computeMealCost, or vice versa, and the solution itself contains mixed references. This inconsistent naming across problem, template, and solution increases extraneous cognitive load and can lead to incorrect method names or confusion about the expected API.
issues.suggested_fix: Unify the identifier across all artifacts. Rename the solution method computeMealCost(Meal) to calculateTotalPrice(Meal) (static) to match the problem statement, and update all references (including commented examples in both template and solution Main) to calculateTotalPrice. Alternatively, provide a static wrapper named calculateTotalPrice that delegates to computeMealCost to preserve existing implementation while matching the required API.
